codes.means: CATALOG.md names no standard (it has no header, or its header names none), the bare unversioned URL, or another kind's standard
codes.fix: hdsop-md stamp <workflows-dir> --apply. A catalog with no header is given one when the Supersuit beside it keeps catalog headers (any Supersuit with freedom-dev 885ae79f3 or later); an older one refuses to rewrite a catalog that has one, so update it first

codes.means: CATALOG.md names a version of the workflow-catalog standard this validator does not implement
codes.fix: install the hdsop-md version that implements it, or rewrite it to https://hypercontext.wiki/standards/workflow-catalog/v1

codes.means: the workflows folder has no CATALOG.md yet
codes.fix: map a workflow with map-a-workflow, which starts the catalog

codes.means: Supersuit's catalog writer would refuse to rewrite this CATALOG.md, because regenerating it would drop lines outside its header or misplace columns, so no row can be added or updated through it
codes.fix: move the prose under "The honest read", keep one table with the catalog's seven columns in order, or write the rows by hand

codes.means: a row's Doc is not unmapped, drafting or proven
codes.fix: set it to unmapped, drafting or proven

codes.means: a row's Automation is not manual, assisted, skill-partial, mostly-automated or judgment-core
codes.fix: set it to one of manual, assisted, skill-partial, mostly-automated, judgment-core

codes.means: two rows name the same workflow (ignoring case)
a row's map link points at a file that does not exist
codes.fix: point the link at the map, or set the cell to - when there is none

codes.means: a row is marked proven with no map to point at
codes.fix: link the map, or lower Doc to drafting or unmapped

codes.means: a row claims skill-partial or mostly-automated and names nothing that automates it
codes.fix: fill Automated by: skill, script, cron, agent-loop, hook, mcp, external, or what actually does it

codes.means: a row is judgment-core, which means it stays human, and still names something as automating it
codes.fix: clear Automated by, or move the row off judgment-core
